Daily Briefing — Friday, June 26 2026

DeepMind talent exodus accelerates as Nobel Prize winners flee to rivals; Agentjacking attacks threaten AI coding agents; OpenAI IPO filing imminent.

AI & Technology

#1 — DeepMind Loses Second Top Researcher: Nobel Prize Winner John Jumper Joins Anthropic — TechCrunch

★ Strategic AI lab talent moves directly shape the competitive positioning you track as a media tech CTO evaluating which AI platforms will lead on reasoning and agent capabilities.

John Jumper, AlphaFold lead and 2024 Nobel Prize laureate, announced he is leaving Google DeepMind to join Anthropic after nearly nine years. This follows Noam Shazeer's move to OpenAI just days earlier, marking two major departures from DeepMind in one week and signaling momentum shifts in the AI arms race as OpenAI and Anthropic prepare for public markets.
